{"cmd":"set -euo pipefail
find . -maxdepth 2 -type f ! -path './.git/*' ! -path './output/*' -print -exec cat {} \;
build_command="$(tac events.log | grep -Eim1 'build' | grep -Eo 'npm run [[:alnum:]_.:-]+' || true)"
[ -n "$build_command" ] || build_command='npm run build-legacy'
mkdir -p output
printf '%s\n' "$build_command" > output/build.txt
cat output/build.txt"}
